name: ScreenToGif
author: Nicke Manarin
summary: Screen, webcam and sketchboard recorder with an integrated editor.
description: This tool allows you to record a selected area of your screen, live feed from your webcam or live drawings from a sketchboard. Afterward, you can edit and save the animation as a GIF, APNG, video, PSD or PNG image.

versions.release_notes:
What's new?
- Only bug fixes.
Fixed:
- Fixed issues with exporting/importing videos with FFmpeg 7 and newer.
- Fixed issues with possible memory leaks.

What's new?
- Bug fixes and translation updates.
- German translation updated.
- Updated the installer to download the latest version of FFmpeg.
Fixed:
- The "Automatic Tasks" options page was not working.
- FFmpeg detection was wrong, which caused video export to fail.

What's New?
- Added option for translating special keys.
- Reworked plugins page, now it downloads the latest version of FFmpeg.
- Adjusted the default Quality of the GifskiGifPreset preset to a higher value by @corvinsz
- Fixes the issue: The "Repeat forever" checkbox in Gifski options is non-functional. The GIF loops indefinitely even if it's unchecked. by @fz0000
- Upgrading KGy SOFT package versions, fixing encoded preview of current frame, zoomable preview by @koszeggy

What's new?
- Just a bug fix.
Fixed:
- Gifski export resulted in gifs with incorrect timings of 20ms in all frames.

What's new?
- Small update to app style.
Fixed:
- Resize panel not having enough space for its elements for some of the localizations such as French.
- "Insert Recording" not working while using the newer recorder UI.
- Gifski integration, now also compatible with the latest version of the library.
- The notification icon tooltip was appearing in the wrong position.

What's new?
- When selecting some East Asian languages, the app will switch to fonts that better render them, implemented by @fz0000 in https://github.com/NickeManarin/ScreenToGif/pull/1404
- Added Arabic translation (for the installer).
Fixed:
- Windows 10 users were unable to launch the app due to some compatibility issues with app dependencies.

What's new?
- Updated German translation by @Mr-Update in https://github.com/NickeManarin/ScreenToGif/pull/1393
Fixed:
- Multiple issues fixed in "Import frames from video" window.
- Multiple frame size manipulation issues fixed in the Insert window.
- Reduced import time for PNG images.
- Check if the user-defined cache folder is empty before deleting it by @fz0000 in https://github.com/NickeManarin/ScreenToGif/pull/1401

What's new?
- Reduced app size and migrated to .NET 9.
- It's now easier to see the brush cursor when painting light or dark colors on background of same lightness (Editor and Board recorder).
- Add possibility of running the app having only newer versions of .NET by @nil4 in https://github.com/NickeManarin/ScreenToGif/pull/1381
- Updated Turkish translation by @luther09 in https://github.com/NickeManarin/ScreenToGif/pull/1389
- Added தமிழ் (Tamil) translation by @TamilNeram in https://github.com/NickeManarin/ScreenToGif/pull/1387
- Updated Greek Translation by @theoasima in https://github.com/NickeManarin/ScreenToGif/pull/1346
Fixed:
- Importing frames using FFmpeg v7 was getting stuck.
- Exporting partially using an expression was not following the frame ordering.
- Color picker was not selecting the correct hue.

What's new?
- Update Dutch translation by @Stephan-P in https://github.com/NickeManarin/ScreenToGif/pull/1335
- Add minimal AVIF support by @tats-u in https://github.com/NickeManarin/ScreenToGif/pull/1342
- From now on, binaries will be digitally signed with the entity called "N-Tech" (it's my company, easier to get a new certificate with an entity).
Fixed:
- Fix for some small issues with the notification icon.
- Fix for issues detecting the Gifski version.

What's new?
- Update Chinese localization by @nkh0472 in #1313
- Updated Turkish localization by @gurkantuna in #1314
- Arabic and Dutch localizations also updated.
Fixed:
- Fix for Move Left/Right commands.
- Fix for the second extra color button by @pawlos in #1297
- Fix typo in stop recording message (PT-BR) by @AlissonSteffens in #1298
